rows.text: The .github/ directory is platform-owned: edits to workflows need Priya's team on the review.

Worker queue names are email, images, billing-sync and webhooks; services/worker/src/queues.ts has typed QUEUE_NAMES, Queues and isQueueName. Known bug: apps/api/src/jobs/enqueue.ts:31 enqueues to "billing_sync" (underscore), so those jobs are silently dropped; not yet fixed (reviewer suggested a follow-up issue).
Team rule: use date-fns for dates; moment is banned (apps/web/lib/format-date.ts now uses date-fns; moment is still listed in apps/web/package.json line 34 and may be removed).

The API's CORS is a fixed allowlist (@fastify/cors with config.allowedOrigins, credentials true) registered in apps/api/src/app.ts; Vercel preview URLs change per deploy so they are blocked (Lena's preview deploy was blocked). Source of allowedOrigins not yet traced.

Invoice PDF rendering (services/worker/src/pdf/invoice-pdf.ts): a null invoice.body crashed the email queue and unended PDFDocuments leaked memory causing staging worker OOMKills; fixed with body?.lines guard and try/finally doc.end(). Always end PDFKit documents.

trailmix requirements.txt (Django 5.1.2, django-htmx 1.21.0, psycopg 3.2.3, pillow 11.0.0) does not include gpxpy; the import_gpx management command needs it and waits for Jordan's go-ahead to add it.

acme-platform local setup: pnpm install (also installs lefthook hooks), copy .env.example to .env.local and fill secrets from the 1Password acme-dev vault, `docker compose up -d db redis`, then `pnpm dev`. The email queue only drains if the worker runs locally (`pnpm --filter worker dev`). Jordan got a new laptop on 2026-10-10.

The prod API (api.acme.dev) is exposed through a Kubernetes Ingress using the AWS Load Balancer Controller (internet-facing ALB, HTTP->HTTPS redirect) with an ACM certificate; ACM certs renew automatically via DNS validation, so only the validation CNAME in the acme.dev zone must remain. Priya asked about cert renewal.

Grafana dashboards are JSON files in infra/grafana/dashboards (api-overview, billing, worker-images). worker-images.json uses guessed metric names (worker_jobs_completed_total, worker_jobs_failed_total, worker_job_duration_seconds_bucket) that were not verified against what the worker exports.
Preference for hydration mismatches in apps/web (Next.js): format dates on the client inside useEffect rather than using suppressHydrationWarning (server renders UTC, browser local time).

Plan: add a read replica for the prod db on branch acme-431-prod-read-replica, and check prod replication lag; unresolved as of 2026-10-12 (which IaC stack owns the prod db instance and how to reach prod for the lag query were not known).
apps/web dark mode is handled by next-themes with the class strategy: use Tailwind dark: variants or :global(.dark) selectors, never prefers-color-scheme media queries.

After the paid_at column was added in schema.ts, local dev DB lacked it (GET /v1/invoices 500: column invoices.paid_at does not exist); the local migration procedure was not known and Jordan was asked how he normally applies SQL locally.

trailmix is deployed on fly.io (app trailmix, region yyz); the suggested way to run Django migrations on every deploy is [deploy] release_command = "python manage.py migrate --noinput" in fly.toml, keeping migrations backwards compatible.

Branch ts-verbatim-imports swaps isolatedModules for verbatimModuleSyntax in tsconfig.base.json, producing 61 TS1484 errors in 44 files (web 27, api 18, worker 9, cli 7); biome check --write with lint/style/useImportType fixes all 61. Full list in /tmp/ts1484-sites.txt.
deps-bot policy: minor dependency bumps (e.g. typescript 5.7.2 PR #1199, drizzle-orm 0.36.1 PR #1198) wait for review; patch bumps automerge after CI.

Customer Dana Whitcombe (Northwind Studio) asked, via Sam Ortiz's forwarded thread on 2026-10-12, for an invoice export for their external Xero bookkeeper: all invoices incl. voided, not just the 25 on screen; columns in order: invoice number, client name, client tax id, issue date, due date, subtotal, tax, total, currency, status, paid date; USD and CAD kept unconverted (currency column or separate files); nice to have: monthly scheduled email on the 1st. They may switch tools otherwise. Current CSV export is client-side from the loaded page (export-csv-button.tsx), no server endpoint; reviewer wants any export work in a separate PR from #1192. No ticket or reply yet.

After editing apps/api/src/db/schema.ts, generate a new migration with `pnpm --filter api drizzle-kit generate` (Drizzle migrations live in apps/api/drizzle; latest is 0042_quiet_hulk.sql, a plain CREATE INDEX invoices_org_id_idx).

Migration 0042 invoices_org_id_idx is a plain CREATE INDEX: staging invoices (1.9M rows, 1.2 GB) blocked writes for 6.8s in a dry run; prod is ~4x larger so expect ~25-30s of blocked writes. CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY would need a hand-written migration outside a transaction since drizzle wraps each file in one. Decision pending.

In acme-platform web app, every browser call to the API must go through the shared wrapper apps/web/lib/api.ts (api() and apiBlob()), which sets credentials: include so the session cookie is sent; raw fetch calls omit the cookie and 401 in staging (reported by Lena).
API routes in acme-platform are versioned under /v1 (e.g. /v1/invoices/:id/void, /v1/invoices/export, /v1/invoices/:id/resend); paths without /v1 are wrong.

The acme CLI (@acme/cli, packages/cli) checks for updates once a day via update-notifier and prints a one-line notice to stderr after the command; it skips the check in CI and NO_UPDATE_NOTIFIER=1 silences it. Latest published version was 2.7.1 on 2026-10-09 (next tag 2.8.0-rc.0).

Metrics and logs go to Grafana Cloud (stack: acme) via the Grafana Agent in each cluster. Dashboards are JSON files in infra/grafana/dashboards; never edit them in the Grafana UI because the sync overwrites UI edits. Preview with `pnpm tsx infra/grafana/sync.ts --dry-run`; CI pushes on main. Alert rules live in infra/grafana/alerts.
A 'billing-sync queue depth' panel (bullmq waiting + active for queue billing-sync) was added to infra/grafana/dashboards/queues.json; the dry-run sync was clean but nothing had been pushed yet.
Decision: the clients table in acme web sorts newest first by default (created_at desc), set in both hooks/use-clients.ts and the clients-table SortHeader default.

Open investigation: some customers are randomly bounced with Unauthorized from the API and it works on refresh. Sentry (7 days): 1,284 events, 61 users, 9 orgs, all three api pods, 87% within 2s of a browser getting a new session, retry always succeeds, flat across the last 3 deploys. Root cause not identified; no prior fix found in git history; the user said they would dig up the old ticket.
In the acme web app, pages that only call redirect() (such as settings/page.tsx redirecting /settings to /settings/profile) are not unit-tested.

Trailmix is a separate Django + htmx project at /Users/jordan/code/trailmix (hikes app). Pattern used: views check the HX-Request header and return partials (hikes/_list.html on success, hikes/_form.html with 422 on validation errors); non-htmx posts still redirect.
The InvoiceRow component in acme web was renamed to InvoiceListItem (files apps/web/components/invoices/invoice-list-item.tsx and its test); no InvoiceRow references remain.

Sam asked for a monthly revenue rollup per org for the finance export. tools/sql/monthly_revenue.sql was written (paid, non-deleted invoices, last 12 months, running total per org, amounts in cents) in plain standard SQL because the database engine/version is unknown; it has not been run against real data.
The agent machine has no kubectl contexts configured, so prod pods cannot be inspected from it; how on-call alerts are routed and who is on the rotation is unknown to the assistant.

Worker crashloop incident Sat 2026-10-17 08:52-09:41: caused by the new invoice-reminder repeatable job registered at startup (commit 4c1d9e2, in Friday's deployed tag); mitigated by disabling the invoice-reminder schedule via feature flag. Root cause suspected in the schedule registration; follow-up ticket filed, incident open for follow-up Monday.

Plan: invoice preview has a 'Copy share link' button using apps/web/lib/share-link.ts, which signs invoiceId.expires with HMAC-SHA256 using env SHARE_LINK_SECRET (7-day expiry) and returns /share/invoices/:id?expires=&sig=. Still to do: add SHARE_LINK_SECRET to .env.example and build the server-side share page that verifies the signature.

Loading skeletons in acme web should only appear if loading takes more than 200ms (to avoid a 50ms flash); use the Delayed component (apps/web/components/delayed.tsx, ms=200). The invoices list loading.tsx uses it.

Trailmix Hike model has a nullable PositiveIntegerField elevation_gain (meters); migration hikes/migrations/0007_hike_elevation_gain.py was generated but the user still has to run `python manage.py migrate`.

Pending task: add a global guard on the acme API org-scoped routes (clients, invoices, orgs, uploads; not health or webhooks) requiring an x-org-id header that matches an org the session belongs to, rejecting otherwise with 403 problem+json. The assistant is waiting for the user to say which HTTP framework and major version the API runs on. The web side already sends the header from apps/web/lib/org-context.ts.
Product copy preference from reviewer: the resend invoice toast should say 'Invoice resent' rather than 'Invoice sent again'.
For 2026-10-18 only, the user asked for much shorter replies.

Decision: .github/workflows/ci.yml has a pdf-perf job (pnpm --filter @acme/pdf perf, about 25 min, 40 min timeout, uploads perf-results.json) running after check on every push and PR because the user wants perf numbers on every change. Caveat: workflow concurrency cancel-in-progress means a new push kills an in-flight run, so busy branches may rarely get numbers.
InvoiceStatus in packages/api-client/src/types.ts now includes "void" (draft | open | paid | uncollectible | void) so the web status badge typechecks.

Dependency audit findings (path-to-regexp via storybook, cookie via msw, cross-spawn 7.0.3 via lefthook) are dev-tooling only and not urgent. Monday's Renovate batch fixes path-to-regexp and cookie; cross-spawn is not covered because lefthook pins execa 5.x and needs a pnpm.overrides entry (cross-spawn >=7.0.5).
Unknown for acme's worker: how in-flight jobs are handled when k8s kills a worker pod mid-deploy (graceful shutdown handling and termination grace period in the Helm chart were not checked).

In acme-platform, apps/web/lib/flags.ts holds only local dev defaults (newInvoiceEditor=false, bulkReminders=true, expenseAttachments=false); real flag values come from an unnamed external 'flag service', and which vendor it is was never confirmed. The org field betaFlags is just a free-form admin-panel label, not used for gating.
Jordan plans to put the invoice export feature behind a feature flag (invoiceExport) for beta orgs only; assistant asked which flag service to use and was awaiting the answer.
Jordan's reviewer prefers structuredClone over JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(x)) for deep copies (JSON round trip loses Dates, Maps, undefined and throws on cycles).

Jordan has a side project 'trailmix' in ~/code/trailmix: a Django app with htmx for logging hikes (models Hike, views hikes/views.py, templates hikes/list.html and _row.html). The hike form targets #hike-rows (tbody) with hx-swap=afterbegin; whole-table outerHTML swap was the bug.

Receipt PDF attachments on expenses (acme-platform): no attachment/multipart handling exists in the expense form or apps/api expenses route. Jordan said they would ask Marco about the storage side; the fallback proposal is a multipart POST via @fastify/multipart (new dependency, not to be added without Jordan's OK, sends all bytes through API pods) storing an attachment row with org_id. Blocked until Marco answers.
Marco is the person Jordan consults about storage decisions (file storage for acme-platform).

acme-platform stack: pnpm monorepo (apps/web Next.js + React + shadcn/ui + react-hook-form + zod + tanstack-query, apps/api Fastify + drizzle + zod, services/worker, packages/cli @acme/cli); tests use vitest (`pnpm --filter web test`); CI is ci.yml on PRs with Vercel previews and staging at staging.acme.dev.

Utility maskIban(iban) lives in apps/web/lib/format.ts (keeps last 4 visible, groups in 4s, uppercases, strips spaces); tests in apps/web/lib/format.test.ts. formatCents and initials are also in format.ts.
trailmix Hike model has elevation_gain_m (PositiveIntegerField, null/blank) added in migration hikes/migrations/0007_hike_elevation_gain_m.py (applied to local SQLite; 41 tests pass).

OrgSwitcher in acme web (apps/web/components/nav/OrgSwitcher.tsx) now uses the shadcn Popover component (closes on outside click and Escape); PR #1484 (acme-431-org-switcher-close) approved, reviewer nit: add a test that Escape closes it (non-blocking).
ClientSearch debounces its query 300ms via useDebouncedValue in apps/web/hooks/use-debounced-value.ts (placeholderData keeps previous results). Reuse this hook for other search boxes.
Zod schema expenseCategoryBody (name trimmed 1-60, color #rrggbb hex, optional parentId uuid) is in apps/api/src/schemas/expenses.ts next to createExpenseBody.

Production build of the release branch on Vercel fails: 'Missing or invalid publishable key for production. Development keys cannot be used in production builds' on /invoices prerender. The env var NEXT_PUBLIC_AUTH_PUBLISHABLE_KEY in Production scope was changed ~3 days before 2026-10-20; suspected a dev-instance key pasted into Production. Jordan was to verify in the auth provider dashboard. Unresolved as of 2026-10-20.

Hydration mismatch gotcha: InvoiceDueDate (apps/web/components/invoices/InvoiceDueDate.tsx) used toLocaleString('en-US') in render, so server (UTC) and browser (Jordan is in Toronto, America/Toronto timezone) differ. Jordan had not decided between user-local time and a fixed timezone.

GET /v1/clients excludes archived clients unless ?includeArchived=true. The flag is parsed as the literal enum 'true'/'false' (not z.coerce.boolean(), which would turn "false" into true). Sort is case-insensitive via lower(name), id tie-break.

Known bug: GET /v1/clients cursor pagination uses `id > cursor` while ordering by lower(name), id, so pages can skip or repeat rows. Proposed fix: (lower(name), id) keyset cursor, left as a follow-up pending Jordan's go-ahead.
Jordan's branch naming for acme-platform: acme-<ticket number>-<slug> (e.g. acme-447-render-fallback, acme-431-org-switcher-close, acme-452-clients-page-size); PRs are tracked by those tickets.

apps/web/app/error.tsx is the root error boundary fallback ('Something went wrong', digest reference, Try again calls reset()); it hides error messages so internal details don't leak. Committed 9b3e1d7 on acme-447-render-fallback, not pushed as of 2026-10-21.

Invoice list filters (status, clientId, from, to) now live in URL search params via useSearchParams and router.replace in InvoiceFilters.tsx, so Back restores them (parseInvoiceFilters in lib/types/invoice.ts); merged in main as 7d20c4e 'url-backed invoice filters'.

slugify(input, maxLength=64) is in apps/web/lib/slugify.ts: NFKD accent stripping plus a lookup table for letters without decomposition (ß, ø, æ, œ, đ, ł, þ); collapses dashes and trims trailing dash after truncation.
Preference: Jordan wants the Django admin trailmix distance shown as '<n.n> km' via an @admin.display method `distance` with ordering='distance_km' in hikes/admin.py.

On 2026-10-21 a customer reported the 'Continue with Google' sign-in button vanished since 2026-10-20. No code change explains it (only Lena Fischer's a81f2c3 login layout tweak). Suspects: Google social connection disabled for the production instance in the auth provider dashboard, or Google OAuth client secret expired/rotated. Jordan was checking the dashboard; the auth provider's identity was not stated.
Lena Fischer is a teammate on acme-platform who works on the web login/layout (commit a81f2c3 'tighten sign-in card layout on small screens', 2026-10-19).

The getting-started page (apps/web/app/(dashboard)/getting-started/page.tsx) embeds the onboarding video via OnboardingVideo component using youtube-nocookie.com, video id aB3xK9qLm2Q, aspect-video 16:9.
getPrimaryCurrency(invoice, orgCurrency) in apps/web/lib/invoice-currency.ts returns the first line item's currency, else the org currency. Supported CurrencyCode: USD, CAD, EUR, GBP, AUD.

Added public /pricing page (plans from apps/web/content/plans.ts: Starter $19, Growth $49, Agency $129 per month) and /settings/team page listing org members via getOrgMembers; both placed directly under apps/web/app and the layout/route group was not confirmed with Jordan; team page relies on upstream signed-in check, no own redirect.

Pending: Jordan wanted a real-browser e2e test of create-invoice-and-send against the local dev server; assistant asked which browser test runner/folder to use and whether to sign in via UI or a saved session; Jordan said they'd find out. Selectors: Client label, 'Line N description/quantity/unit price' aria-labels, buttons 'Save draft' and 'Send invoice' (only shown for drafts).

Deliberate decision: the misspelling 'recieved' in apps/api/src/routes/v1/payments.ts is an API response value (status: 'recieved') and is intentionally left as-is by Jordan (clients may match it; payments.test.ts expects it); only worker comment/log typos were fixed. Possible later API cleanup.

ClientPicker prop is now onClientSelect (renamed from onSelect, which shadows the DOM event); call sites NewInvoiceForm, InvoiceFilters, ExpenseFilters. ClientsTable PAGE_SIZES is [10,20,50,100]; API clients limit caps at 100.
toCsv in apps/web/lib/csv.ts already writes the header row and escapes cells; don't prepend your own header (ExportCsvButton had duplicated it, fixed).
scripts/count-todos.ts counts TODO/FIXME per package (run `pnpm tsx scripts/count-todos.ts`). As of 2026-10-23: web 30, api 24, worker 10, cli 4; 9 of 54 markers reference a Linear id.

acme CLI (`acme invoices list`, packages/cli): client column truncated to 24 chars with an ellipsis (truncate() exported from render.ts; reviewer suggests moving it to src/lib/text.ts if reused); --json returns the full name.

Unfinished: `acme invoices list --since <YYYY-MM-DD>` (issue date filter, validated by parseSince, UsageError exit code 2, passed as issuedFrom). Still to do: register the flag in packages/cli/src/index.ts, add issuedFrom to api/client.ts invoices.list types, confirm the API supports an issued-from filter, add tests for parseSince. The CLI README already documents --since, so it is ahead of the code.
